events.verdict: [Observable in enhanced video] Westbrook (OKC) fails to fully clear and is in the lane for more than three seconds without actively guarding an opponent.
Adams (OKC) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Tatum (BOS) and sets a legal pick as he absorbs the contact.
Horford (BOS) makes contact to the body of Adams (OKC) during his shooting motion that affects his driving shot attempt.
Smart (BOS) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Westbrook (OKC) and sets a legal pick as he absorbs the contact.
Smart (BOS) firms up and absorbs the contact from George (OKC) during the screen.
Tatum (BOS) initiates contact by clamping and wiping George's (OKC) arm during the screen, affecting his ability to defend.
Adams (OKC) makes marginal contact with Tatum (BOS) during the pick as he leans his arm into the back of Tatum.
LLB shows Westbrook (OKC) does not step out of bounds.
[Observable in enhanced video] Schroder (OKC) lifts his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Irving (BOS) makes marginal contact to Schroder's (OKC) arm during the start of the drive, but does not affect his SQBR.
Brown (BOS) cleanly blocks Schroder's (OKC) driving shot attempt as the ball is still on it's upward flight.
Grant (OKC) initiates body contact that dislodges Morris (BOS) and affects his ability to rebound.
Irving (BOS) is slightly late to the spot when he makes body contact with Westbrook (OKC) at the end of his drive, but doesn't affect his ability to pass.
MOB shows Morris (BOS) makes contact to Grant's (OKC) arm affecting his shot attempt near the rim. Horford (BOS) avoids making contact as he defends the shot attempt.
Smart (BOS) and Ferguson (OKC) briefly engage and separate off-ball.
Westbrook (OKC) cleanly dislodges the ball from Horford (BOS) after recovering the loose ball.
Ferguson (OKC) maintains a legal guarding position on Irving (BOS) as he tips the ball during Irving's pass attempt.
Irving (BOS) moves under Westbrook (OKC) as he jumps in the air that dislodges him during the loose ball.
Horford (BOS) makes marginal contact with Ferguson (OKC), but doesn't affect his ability to set the pick.
Westbrook (OKC) is in the lane for longer than three seconds.
[Observable in enhanced video] Smart (BOS) touches the ball while it is in the imaginary cylinder above the rim.
Tatum (BOS) slightly extends his arm into the body of Westbrook (OKC) during his drive towards the rim, but does not affect his SQBR.
Grant (OKC) makes marginal contact with Tatum (BOS) as he moves into his path during the screen.
Westbrook (OKC) commits a take foul on Tatum (BOS).
Grant (OKC) makes marginal body contact with Smart (BOS) as he dislodges the ball during the rebound.
Irving (BOS) maintains legal guarding position as Westbrook (OKC) loses control of the ball.
Adams (OKC) commits a take foul on Tatum (BOS).
[Observable in enhanced video] Irving (BOS) stands inside the arc during the release on the missed free throw attempt.
Irving (BOS) extends his arm into the body of Westbrook (OKC) during his shooting motion that affects his driving shot attempt.
Grant (OKC) makes marginal contact to Irving's (BOS) body as Grant attempts to get to the pass.
Adams (OKC) commits a take foul on Smart (BOS).
Tatum (BOS) makes a clean block during George's (OKC) jump shot on the perimeter.
